# Bar D Construction & Land Services

> Locally owned, family operated construction company in Stephenville, Texas (Erath County). Builds turnkey metal buildings ground up, works as a general contractor on any ground-up build, and handles land clearing, demolition, concrete, fencing, arenas, welding, drainage, and roll-off dumpster rental within 75 miles of Stephenville.

## Facts

- Business name: Bar D Construction & Land Services
- Owner: Ryan Davidson
- Phone: (512) 525-6475
- Base: Stephenville, Texas, Erath County
- Service area: 75 miles in every direction from Stephenville
- Years: 12 years in the industry, 7+ years operating as Bar D
- Structure: locally owned and family operated; work executed through fully licensed and insured subcontractors coordinated by Bar D as the general contractor
- Recognition: nominated for Best of Erath 2026, Home and Services category
- Primary service: ground-up turnkey metal building construction (steel structure, welding, site work, foundation, and every licensed finish trade under one contract)
- Distinctive build: two-container shipping container retreat with three private suites, bunk room, kitchen, living area, bathroom, covered porch, and overlook deck, delivered serviced with water, septic, AC, and heat
- Dumpster rental sizes: 11 yard, 15 yard, 18 yard roll-offs, delivered, picked up, and dumped; daily, weekly, or extended rental; same-day haul off and return; discounted pricing for multiple haul-offs
- Septic: coordinated through TCEQ-licensed installers, permit pulled under the installer's license
- Not offered: swimming pools. That is the only exclusion.
- Quotes: free on every job, always. No pricing is published; every price is quoted after a site walk.
- Language: English
- Positioning in their own words: "No project is too big. No detail is too small." and "Quality work done right the first time."

## Full service list

Metal buildings and construction, general contracting, shipping container conversions, land services and land improvements, land clearing, demolition, concrete and driveways and sidewalks and decking, fencing (pipe, creosote, ranch), arenas, custom entrances, welding and fabrication, drainage correction, barns and outbuildings, septic via licensed subcontractors, roll-off dumpster rental.
